finding: Commit 0e53d6aa adds three refusals to BR-118 and to the merge-story and return-story bullets of the interface contracts, and no Scenario of run-lifecycle.feature traces any of them. First, a hook refuses the amend that writes status: done into the merge commit, merge-story exits 1, names the hooks, and leaves the entry dispatched. Second, git refuses the reset --keep after a red test suite, and the entry stays dispatched until a rerun. Third, return-story finds no status line in backlog/<id>.md, exits 1, and saves no change to the ledger. The tests RL-02-IT-02 in tests/factory/test_run_lifecycle_dispatch.py cover the first refusal without a Scenario to point to. Add one Scenario for each refusal to RL-02 or RL-06, next to 'A red test suite after a merge moves the feature branch back' and the return-story Outline. Owner: requirements-agent.
why_this_severity: The contract bullets define each refusal with its exit code, message and ledger state, so an implementer and a test writer can act (no to fails_purpose); a reader who looks for the behavior in the feature file finds nothing and must turn to the contract (raises_cost).
